title: almost immortal
description: this mod makes you almost invincible
body:
This mod makes you almost inmortal the only way you can die is cuz of fal damage.
# bugs
There is only one bug in this project:
If you fall from a hight place you die but you can only respawn bij clicking on **_title screen_** and then on **_respawn_**.

If you find any other bugs please let me know.

This mod was made for a modpack thats not ready yet.
